About us

Innovative Assessments (IA) is a fintech startup that uses psychometrics to assess creditworthiness based on a borrower's personal character. Our mission is to facilitate financial inclusion by helping banks approve more loans among the unbanked, and by helping more people qualify for the affordable credit they deserve. We operate in +20 countries, and work with some of the world's best banks and fintechs. Please contact us for more information!
